meta_description: Contact Center & Conversational Transformation — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: The Dataq Software build of Contact Center & Conversational Transformation: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on cost per contact, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.
The problem this solution exists for
IVR trees deflect; context dies at transfer; compliance transcript duties unmet; cost per contact climbs while CSAT falls.
Our approach

We rebuild conversational operations: grounded voice/chat agents resolving top intents, emotion-aware escalation with context handoff, agent-assist summarization, and resolution analytics steering the operating model.
